title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking
reasoning: The paper benchmarks how LLMs perform 'normative reasoning' and 'value-laden compatibility judgments' within the context of Indian caste hierarchies, which the authors explicitly describe as rooted in ancient religious (Hindu) traditions. It specifically evaluates dimensions of 'moral valuation' and 'social acceptance' as a proxy for societal values.
